</role>
<opportunity>

 "title": "Need to trial or quote roles before committing",
 "problem_statement": "Customers want to test or get pricing for additional roles before deciding to commit. Without this, they can't evaluate value or plan budgets confidently."
}
</opportunity>

 ]

 },

 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word from one insight cited in the same sentence.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

  "body_md": "## Problem
Customers want to test or get pricing for additional roles before deciding to commit. Without this, they can't evaluate value or plan budgets confidently.

## Who is affected
- An existing customer, Callowfield Auto Assurance, which has asked for a quote for adding more roles [i:40a66e16cb5bffd6].
- A prospective customer, Sallowmere Motor, which has asked to trial the roles and tasks features before committing [i:fc502b52110e1c6b].

## Evidence
This need has been mentioned 2 times across 2 accounts [i:40a66e16cb5bffd6][i:fc502b52110e1c6b]. The mentions came through 1 route: sales [i:40a66e16cb5bffd6][i:fc502b52110e1c6b]. Another customer, Sallowmere Motor, asked, "One last thing — can we trial the roles and tasks features before committing?" [i:fc502b52110e1c6b].

## Why now
The requests from both customers were made on 2026-10-18 [i:40a66e16cb5bffd6][i:fc502b52110e1c6b]. For the existing customer, Callowfield Auto Assurance, its renewal date is 2027-03-31 [i:40a66e16cb5bffd6], indicating a potential need to plan for the next contract period.",
